verdict.rationale: Rainforest's own docs describe outbound webhooks that notify the platform of status changes on resources. Users can configure them for payment, merchant, deposit and chargeback lifecycle events, and dedicated guides cover receiving them on-prem and through no-code tools, so a programmatic consumer can subscribe to events. missing for 10: documented registration mechanics (API or portal endpoint setup), signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Rainforest utilizes webhooks to notify the platform when an event occurs, which indicates a change of status on a resource in the Rainforest ecosystem.
Configure Rainforest to send webhook notifications for any payment, merchant, or deposit events
You can subscribe to events for the following resources
Webhooks can be configured to receive updates on every status change that occurs through the lifecycle of a chargeback.
It covers three patterns for receiving Rainforest webhooks to an on-prem service.
